title: Trivia
tagline: Fifteen questions: the wider world, food, Pittsburgh and Ohio State.
howTo: Fifteen questions, a different mix every game.
Tap your answer fast: quicker right answers score more.
One answer each. No changing your mind.
Food questions show a photo of a dish. Name it.

questions.question: Who is the only player to win the Heisman Trophy twice?
questions.fact: The Ohio State running back won it in 1974 and 1975.

questions.question: Which instrument does the band member who dots the i in Script Ohio play?

questions.fact: Tressel coached the Buckeyes from 2001 to 2010.

questions.question: What exactly is a buckeye?
questions.answer: The nut of Ohio's state tree
questions.fact: It is said to look like the eye of a male deer, a buck.
